caption: The drawing features a collection of hexagonal shapes arranged in a compact, tessellated pattern, resembling a patchwork quilt. Each hexagon is colored and patterned differently: some are solid, while others have stripes, dots, or floral motifs. The hexagons include colors such as red, green, blue, beige, and brown. Red hexagons feature a floral or leafy white design. There are green and dark blue hexagons with a solid or lightly textured appearance. Light gray and beige hexagons have diagonal or horizontal stripes, while several white hexagons have blue dots or lines. Some sections of the drawing include patterns that resemble fabric textures. The background around the hexagons is plain, uncolored, and the signature "ELGIN MCSYLL" is present below the drawing.
title: Silk Quilt - "Honeycomb" Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
